description: The Federal University of Technology–Paraná team publishes 1,660 images of one Brazilian distribution substation, with 50,705 annotations across fifteen equipment classes. Insulators, transformers, breakers and disconnect switches appear under different lighting, weather and camera positions over two years. Zenodo provides JPEG images, polygonal JSON labels, PNG masks and conversion support freely under CC BY 4.0. The dataset can train asset-recognition models used to initialise substation inventories or inspection digital-twin simulations. It does not encode electrical connectivity, and the single-site collection may limit transfer to different equipment or substations. Classes are strongly imbalanced, with porcelain pin insulators most common. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
